title: 区间列表的交集
summary: 两个列表各自由互不相交且已排序的闭区间组成，返回两列表所有区间交集。
insight: 当前两区间交集端点是 max(start) 与 min(end)；记录非空交集后，结束更早的区间不可能再与对方后续相交，移动对应指针。
pitfalls: 闭区间在端点相等时也有一个点的交集
两个区间同一时刻结束可移动任一侧

solutions.title: 双列表区间扫描
solutions.idea: 比较当前区间并淘汰先结束者。
steps: 若 first end<second end 则 i++，否则 j++；任一列表耗尽后返回

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] intervalIntersection(int[][] firstList,int[][] secondList){List<int[]> answer=new ArrayList<>();int i=0,j=0;while(i<firstList.length&&j<secondList.length){int low=Math.max(firstList[i][0],secondList[j][0]),high=Math.min(firstList[i][1],secondList[j][1]);if(low<=high)answer.add(new int[]{low,high});if(firstList[i][1]<secondList[j][1])i++;else j++;}return answer.toArray(new int[0][]);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun intervalIntersection(firstList:Array<IntArray>,secondList:Array<IntArray>):Array<IntArray>{val answer=mutableListOf<IntArray>();var i=0;var j=0;while(i<firstList.size&&j<secondList.size){val low=maxOf(firstList[i][0],secondList[j][0]);val high=minOf(firstList[i][1],secondList[j][1]);if(low<=high)answer.add(intArrayOf(low,high));if(firstList[i][1]<secondList[j][1])i++ else j++};return answer.toTypedArray()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<vector<int>> intervalIntersection(vector<vector<int>>& firstList,vector<vector<int>>& secondList){vector<vector<int>> answer;int i=0,j=0;while(i<(int)firstList.size()&&j<(int)secondList.size()){int low=max(firstList[i][0],secondList[j][0]),high=min(firstList[i][1],secondList[j][1]);if(low<=high)answer.push_back({low,high});if(firstList[i][1]<secondList[j][1])++i;else ++j;}return answer;} };
